works.body: Following up on the tweet, ask Regris what he'd like. If you tell him Sam did it he'll know what it was from. Doubled the price because it is extra work for you to have to do this. Enjoy!

Hey Shqueq

So Sarah here is, more or less, loosely based off of the aesthetic of Final Fantasy Tactics, and one of the primary elements of FFT is the Job System.

So in that vein, since it's October and all, I wanted to ask her drawn in different class outfits! They can be from the game itself, or something original of your creation. Maybe a wizard's outfit, or a monk? Or perhaps something like a samurai or dragoon?

I'll leave the choices up to you! If you could do several SD style images (if it's not too much trouble) I'd be really happy, but one single image is fine too 👍

References: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Am6V1EkJ7vr6XVfbsdCsV0O2sW65vrGL

Good evening Shqueq!　I want to entrust you with one of my most precious illustrations.
I want you to draw an illustration of Anne, Rita and Greer in a hot spring.
The location is a volcanic area in Greer's hometown, and Anne, Rita and Greer are bathing in a hot spring that was naturally formed there, with towels wrapped around their bodies.
It is nighttime, and the hot springs are reflecting the night sky with stars. Please give us a beautiful illustration of the three of them looking up at the beautiful starry sky.

Pose, placement, starry sky, and hot spring should be based on the illustration in "General View & Placement".
Each of the three has a designated image for facial expressions. Please refer to those.
Place Anne on the left, Grea in the middle, and Rita on the right.
All three are smiling happily.

Please help us again.
Please take care of the three of us.

Shqueq how do you feel about drawing robot girls my dude?

I wanted to request art of Magellan, an original character of mine that's an android explorer that was created in the wake of humanity's decline in the near future.

She's a calm and level-headed kind of character with a lot of curiosity, with her self-stated mission to explore worlds and places that both humans and machines haven't yet visited. I have no preferences for pose and will leave the composition to your judgement. 🙇‍♂️

Hello, Mr. Shukuek. I have come to ask for an illustration request.
I would like an illustration of "Anne in Rita's jacket hoodie, the two of them closely together and lovey-dovey".

Anne: no blazer, shirt in tatters, sleeves rolled up to the elbows (attire from the second half of the first episode of Manalia Friends).
Rita: usual attire. The jacket is zipped up with Anne wrapped around the front part of the jacket.

Anne is a little tired after a long battle, but she regains her energy by touching Rita.
Rita is holding Anne in her arms, giving her the tender look that she gives her beloved lover.

The background is left to us, and they both look happy.

Please take a look.

Good evening Shqueq.
I would like to request an illustration.

I would like an illustration of Anne, Rita, and Greer at the bakery.

An illustration of a bakery run by three people in designated outfits, working inside the bakery.
Anne and Rita have changed their hairstyles. The clothes are matching uniforms of different colors.
Please leave the background to the interior of the bakery.

Rita:.
She is holding freshly baked bread with tongs and arranging it.
She looks as if she is hungry and wants to eat the bread.
She looks happy.

Anne: Holding a tray of bread in her hands.
She is holding a tray with bread on it in both hands and is receiving Rita's bread on the tray.
She is looking at Rita with a smile and looks very cheerful and happy.

Greer:.
She is in the back compared to the other two. She is carrying a basket with some French bread.
Looking at Anne and Rita, who seem to be in good spirits, Grea also looks happy.

Running a bakery with the three of us is a future dream for Rita.
I hope to greet her with such a happy scene after my story ends someday.
I will leave it to you to figure out what I don't understand or what is unclear.

Please do not hesitate to contact me.
